title: The Evolution of the Firm — with Ben and Marc

reader_summary.headline: It's just as hard to build a small, inconsequential thing as it is to build a giant world-changing thing.
reader_summary.overview: It's just as hard to build a small, inconsequential thing as it is to build a giant world-changing thing. You work the same amount of hours and so you might as well go for doing something important. Social media has become the dog and traditional media has become the tail and they just get whipped around like crazy by all these shifting memes.
